summary: A Hindu religious app (Vrat Katha & Community) with features including TTS narration for kathayen, community post management with admin approval queue, public visibility fixes for vrat kathas and community posts, one-click Internet Identity login/logout, narration fix for PWA, and community photo loading optimization.
architectural_notes: Authentication uses Internet Identity (one-click, no password) for login/logout
Community posts require admin approval before being publicly visible
TTS/Narration must work in both browser and PWA (installed) mode
known_issues: Narration (TTS) works on web browser but fails in PWA/downloaded app
Vrat Katha uploads only visible to admin, not public users
Community approved posts not showing to public users
Community photos take too long to load after upload

existing_features.title: Implement one-click Internet Identity login/logout: clicking the login button must immediately open the Internet Identity flow (Google/passkey) with no additional password prompt. On successful authentication the user is logged in; a logout button must be visible and functional at all times when authenticated.

Fix Vrat Katha public visibility: when an admin uploads or publishes a Vrat Katha, it must immediately be visible to all public (unauthenticated) users, not only to the admin. The backend query for listing kathas must return all published/active kathas regardless of caller identity, and the frontend must display them without requiring login.

Fix Community posts public visibility: admin-approved community posts must be visible to all users, including unauthenticated/public visitors. The backend query for listing community posts must return approved posts for anonymous callers, and the Community page must render them without requiring login.

Fix Narration (TTS) in PWA/installed app: the text-to-speech narration that works on the desktop browser must also work correctly when the app is installed as a PWA on mobile devices. Update the useSpeechNarration hook and any relevant pages (KathaDetail, AartiDetail, Bhajans, Mantras, Chalisa) to use a PWA-compatible TTS strategy — ensure the Speech Synthesis API is re-initialized after page visibility changes, handle the known Chrome Android PWA bug where voices are not loaded until an utterance event fires, and add a fallback resume mechanism so narration is not silently blocked.

Implement Community Admin Control panel: the Admin Panel must include a dedicated 'Community Approval Queue' tab listing all pending community posts (text, images, videos). For each pending post the admin must be able to Accept (approve and make public), Reject (decline without publishing), or Delete (permanently remove) the post. Already-approved posts must also be deletable by the admin. Backend must expose the necessary update/delete functions restricted to admin callers.

Optimize Community Photos loading speed: images in community posts must load faster. Implement lazy loading for images in CommunityPostCard (use native loading='lazy' attribute), add image dimension hints to avoid layout shift, and where possible display a low-quality placeholder or skeleton while the full image loads. If images are stored as blobs in the backend, serve them efficiently; avoid re-fetching large blobs on every render by caching blob URLs.

new_feature_requests.summary: One-click Login/Logout via Internet Identity (Google/passkey, no password)
Vrat Katha public visibility fix — uploaded kathas visible to all public users, not just admin
Community posts public visibility — admin-approved posts visible to all users
Narration (TTS) fix for PWA/downloaded app — narration works after install on mobile
Community Admin Control — approval queue with accept/reject/delete for posts
Community Photos speed optimization — faster image loading
